Trait-mediated environmental slopes for jsdgam()

Source: R/trait_slopes.R
trait_slopes_helpers.Rd

Internal helpers that rewrite (obs_formula, trait_slopes) into the brms non-linear formula that parameterises the fourth-corner regression

Details

$$\beta_{s,k} = \sum_l T_{s, l}\, \gamma_{l, k} + \epsilon_{s, k}$$

where every fixed slope on an environmental covariate becomes a trait-regressed nlpar carrying its own species-level random deviation. The rewrite expands

obs_formula = y ~ env1 + env2 trait_slopes = ~ trait1

into

bf(y ~ a + b1 * env1 + b2 * env2, a ~ trait1 + (1 | sp | species), b1 ~ trait1 + (1 | sp | species), b2 ~ trait1 + (1 | sp | species), nl = TRUE)

The |sp| correlated-random-effect tag jointly parameterises the species-level intercept and slope deviations under an LKJ prior so the trait wrapper composes with the rest of the jsdgam factor model. The actual nl plumbing (priors, parameter aliasing, discovery for marginaleffects) is in R/insight.mvgam.R, R/as.data.frame.mvgam.R and R/conditional_effects.mvgam.R.
